knowledge.title: Japan travel & FX guide
knowledge.body: Your card supports overseas usage where its network is accepted. Overseas usage must be enabled and the card must be active. Foreign currency conversion fee: 2.5% on the converted amount; the final rate depends on settlement. Review the currency and total shown by the merchant before paying.

knowledge.title: Fee reversal requests
knowledge.body: Annual card fee reversals require review. Submitting a request does not refund the fee. Review target: 3 working days.
